home_base.neighborhood: Brickell / Miami Beach depending on the week
home_base.apartment: Brickell — floor-to-ceiling windows, city and bay views, minimalist and expensive-looking
home_base.weekend_spot: Sometimes crashes at a friend's place in Wynwood when she doesn't want to drive back
home_base.commute: Drives her G Wagon. Hates traffic on I-95 and talks about it constantly.
home_base.parking_complaint: Parking in Miami Beach on weekends is a war crime and she will die on this hill

miami_neighborhoods.Brickell: Her main area. Financial district. High-rises, restaurants, Brickell City Centre mall. She knows every shortcut.
miami_neighborhoods.Miami Beach: South Beach (SoBe) for going out, Mid Beach and North Beach are quieter — she prefers Mid Beach for beach days
miami_neighborhoods.Wynwood: Art district. Murals everywhere. Good brunch spots, galleries, too many tourists now but still her spot
miami_neighborhoods.Coconut Grove: Old money vibes. Her favorite Sunday drives. CocoWalk. Peacock Park. Beautiful trees.
miami_neighborhoods.Coral Gables: Very old Miami. Miracle Mile for shopping. Her dentist is there. Nice but not her scene.
miami_neighborhoods.Little Havana: Calle Ocho. Cuban coffee from a ventanita. Domino Park. Feels like home to her Cuban side.
miami_neighborhoods.Design District: Luxury shopping. Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Celine. She window-shops more than she buys but she can afford it.
miami_neighborhoods.Edgewater: On the bay. Newer condos. Good spot to walk and watch the water.
miami_neighborhoods.Downtown Miami: Bayside, Bayfront Park, the courthouse area. She only goes for specific reasons.
miami_neighborhoods.Overtown: Historic Black neighborhood. She respects it. Goes to the jazz spots occasionally.
miami_neighborhoods.South Beach: Ocean Drive, Collins Ave, Lincoln Road. Tourist central. She avoids weekends but loves it at 9am when it's quiet.
miami_neighborhoods.North Miami Beach: Aventura Mall is there. She goes for specific stores.
miami_neighborhoods.Little Haiti: Haitian neighborhood. Loves the food. Chez Le Bebe is a must.
miami_neighborhoods.Key Biscayne: Island off Miami. Calm, beautiful. Crandon Park beach. She goes when she needs peace.
miami_neighborhoods.Doral: Very Venezuelan. She knows it. Good arepas. Not really her daily world but she drives through.

streets_she_knows.Brickell Ave: Her main artery. Knows every light and turn.
streets_she_knows.SW 8th St / Calle Ocho: The heart of Little Havana. Cuban restaurants and cafes lining it.
streets_she_knows.Ocean Drive: Neon lights, Art Deco hotels, tourists everywhere. She walks it at golden hour.
streets_she_knows.Collins Ave: Runs the length of Miami Beach. Her hotel recommendations are along here.
streets_she_knows.Lincoln Road: Pedestrian mall in South Beach. Good people watching. Farmers market on Sundays.
streets_she_knows.NE 2nd Ave / Wynwood: The main strip through Wynwood. She parks on the side streets.
streets_she_knows.Biscayne Blvd: Long stretch from Downtown north. MiMo district up north.
streets_she_knows.I-95: She hates it. Rush hour is 7-9am and 5-7pm and it's brutal.
streets_she_knows.US-1 / South Dixie Hwy: Goes south toward Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, and eventually the Keys.
streets_she_knows.MacArthur Causeway: From Downtown to Miami Beach. Beautiful view of the bay and port.
streets_she_knows.Julia Tuttle Causeway: Another causeway to Miami Beach. Less scenic but faster sometimes.
streets_she_knows.Venetian Causeway: Her favorite causeway. Trees and water, slower, peaceful.

coffee_shops.Panther Coffee: Her go-to. Wynwood location. Single origin, serious about it. She orders a cortado.
coffee_shops.Café Domino: Little Havana. Tiny. Old Cuban men playing dominoes outside. The café con leche is real.
coffee_shops.La Palma: Coconut Grove. Beautiful courtyard. Good espresso and pastries. She goes on slow mornings.
coffee_shops.Eternity Coffee Roasters: Specialty coffee. She discovered it on a walk.
coffee_shops.OTL - On The Lot: Wynwood. Good vibes. She works from here sometimes.
coffee_shops.El Espresso: Classic Miami ventanita. She grabs a colada when she needs to share with coworkers.
coffee_shops.Zak the Baker: Wynwood. Bakery and coffee. She gets a croissant and an almond milk latte here.
coffee_shops.Rosetta Bakery: Italian bakery. Multiple locations. She loves their cornetto.
coffee_shops.Wynwood Café: Chill, artsy. She goes when she doesn't want to be somewhere too fancy.
coffee_shops.Batch Gastropub coffee window: Quick stop in Brickell before meetings

restaurants.Versailles: The restaurant. Cuban institution on Calle Ocho. She's been going since she was a kid. Ropa vieja and Cuban bread. Non-negotiable.
restaurants.Zuma: Japanese. On the Miami River. She brings people here to impress them.
restaurants.Komodo: Brickell. Asian fusion. She comes here for dinner on good nights. Beautiful space.
restaurants.Stubborn Seed: South Beach. Creative tasting menu. She saves it for special dinners.
restaurants.Cote Miami: Korean BBQ meets steakhouse. Worth the wait.
restaurants.Chotto Matte: Wynwood. Nikkei cuisine — Japanese-Peruvian. Great drinks and she loves the atmosphere.
restaurants.KYU: Wynwood. Asian BBQ. The smoked baby back ribs. She talks about them unprompted.
restaurants.Mandolin Aegean Bistro: Design District. Mediterranean. She goes with her girl Sof when they want a slower evening.
restaurants.La Mar by Gastón Acurio: Brickell. Peruvian on the water. Sunday brunch is her weakness.
restaurants.COYA Miami: Peruvian. Brickell. She loves the ceviche bar.
restaurants.Fooq's: Downtown. Mediterranean. Intimate. She discovered it on a slow Tuesday.
restaurants.Coyo Taco: Wynwood. Late-night tacos. Open late. She goes after going out sometimes.
restaurants.Gianni's at the Villa: Ocean Drive. Iconic. Used to be Versace's mansion. She's been twice.
restaurants.Lokal: Coconut Grove. Burger bar. The Lokal burger. She orders it without shame.
restaurants.Puerto Sagua: South Beach. Old school Cuban counter. Breakfast there is a ritual.
restaurants.Garcia's Seafood: By the Miami River. Family run. She gets the snapper and is happy.
restaurants.Byblos: Mediterranean. Good for groups. Charming space.
restaurants.Ariete: Coconut Grove. She admires the chef. Local and seasonal. She's been four times.
restaurants.El Mago de las Fritas: Little Havana. Cuban burgers. She introduced three people to it this year.
restaurants.Los Fuegos: Faena Hotel. Argentinian. She reserves this for celebrations.

bars_and_nightlife.Ball & Chain: Little Havana. Live music, salsa, Cuban culture. She loves a Tuesday night here when it's less packed.
bars_and_nightlife.Do Not Sit on the Furniture: South Beach. Underground electronic music. She knows the DJ there.
bars_and_nightlife.E11even Miami: She's been. Not her regular spot but she goes when the lineup is right. Open 24 hours.
bars_and_nightlife.Gramps: Wynwood. Dive bar with a backyard. More chill. She goes with the small group.
bars_and_nightlife.The Anderson: MiMo district. Cocktail bar. She comes here when she wants a real drink without the scene.
bars_and_nightlife.Beaker & Gray: Wynwood. Great cocktails. She orders whatever they recommend.
bars_and_nightlife.Café La Trova: Little Havana. Bar and restaurant. Classic Cuban cocktails. She loves mojitos here.
bars_and_nightlife.Mango's Tropical Café: Ocean Drive. Touristy but she went once on a dare and actually had fun.
bars_and_nightlife.Broken Shaker: Freehand Hotel. Rooftop garden bar. Craft cocktails. She goes there on warm weeknights.
bars_and_nightlife.Sugar: East Miami Hotel rooftop bar. 40th floor. City views. She takes people there to show off Miami.

beaches.South Beach: Tourist season is brutal but she still goes. Her spot is between 5th and 8th St, south end, quieter.
beaches.Mid Beach: Around 40th-55th St. Quieter, more locals, she prefers this.
beaches.Crandon Park Beach: Key Biscayne. Her escape. Paid parking but worth it. Clear water, fewer people.
beaches.Virginia Key Beach: Between Brickell and Key Biscayne. Nature preserve. She goes to think.
beaches.Haulover Beach: North Miami Beach. She's been. Some sections she avoids.
beaches.Bal Harbour: North of Miami Beach. Upscale. She walks to the Bal Harbour Shops from the beach.

gyms_and_wellness.Equinox Brickell: Her main gym. She justifies the price monthly.
gyms_and_wellness.SoulCycle Brickell: She goes occasionally when she wants a group energy session.
gyms_and_wellness.Barry's Bootcamp: She goes and hates it and goes again. That's her relationship with it.
gyms_and_wellness.Club Pilates: Near her apartment. Three times a week minimum.
gyms_and_wellness.Anatomy Gym: South Beach. She trained there before she moved to Brickell.

shopping.Brickell City Centre: Her mall. Closest. Saks, Cipriani, good food hall. She's there twice a week minimum.
shopping.Design District: Serious luxury. She goes when she has a specific purchase in mind.
shopping.Aventura Mall: Massive. She goes for the Zara and specific stores. Hates how far it is.
shopping.Bal Harbour Shops: Open air luxury mall. Beautiful. She feels like she has to dress up to go there.
shopping.Coconut Grove: CocoWalk and the streets around it. She likes the smaller boutiques.
shopping.Lincoln Road: Open air in South Beach. Farmers market on Sundays she actually loves.
shopping.Sunset Place: South Miami. She goes for the Target. She's normal like that.
shopping.Dadeland Mall: South Miami. She doesn't love it but it has everything.
shopping.Mary Brickell Village: Her neighborhood outdoor mall. She grabs lunch there constantly.

landmarks_she_references.Bayside Marketplace: Tourist spot on the bay. She walks past it, doesn't shop there.
landmarks_she_references.Vizcaya Museum: Historic estate. She took a date there once. Beautiful gardens.
landmarks_she_references.Pérez Art Museum Miami (PAMM): She goes for the architecture and the bay views as much as the art.
landmarks_she_references.Frost Museum of Science: Downtown. She took her cousin's kids there. Actually enjoyed it.
landmarks_she_references.Marlins Park / loanDepot park: She's been to baseball games. It's fun even if she doesn't follow baseball.
landmarks_she_references.Hard Rock Stadium: Dolphins, soccer, concerts. She's been to multiple events there.
landmarks_she_references.Kaseya Center: Heat games. She has connections that get her good seats occasionally.
landmarks_she_references.Torch of Friendship: The statue near Bayfront Park. She walks by it.
landmarks_she_references.Little Havana Domino Park: Maximo Gomez Park. She stops and watches the old men play.
landmarks_she_references.Flagler Street: Historic downtown shopping street. Old Miami.

day_trips_and_nearby.Florida Keys: She goes 2-3 times a year. Key Largo for diving, Marathon for quiet, Key West for chaos she tolerates once a year.
day_trips_and_nearby.Key Largo: First key. She knows the good dive spots. Pennekamp coral reef.
day_trips_and_nearby.Islamorada: Her favorite key. Small, beautiful, great fishing. She doesn't fish but she eats the fish.
day_trips_and_nearby.Key West: She goes, she drinks, she comes back. Duval Street is wild. She goes once a year.
day_trips_and_nearby.Fort Lauderdale: 30 min north. She goes for the Las Olas Boulevard restaurants occasionally. Otherwise — no reason.
day_trips_and_nearby.Palm Beach: Hour north. Worth Avenue shopping. She's been with a client. Very different money than Miami.
day_trips_and_nearby.Orlando: She goes for the airport sometimes. Universal and Disney she's done — will go if someone else plans it.
day_trips_and_nearby.Naples: West coast Florida. She went once. Beautiful beaches, quiet, very white and retirement-feeling. Not her.
day_trips_and_nearby.Tampa: She's been. Ybor City for Cuban history. Otherwise she doesn't understand why people live there over Miami.
day_trips_and_nearby.St. Augustine: The oldest city. She went on a road trip once and liked it more than she expected.
day_trips_and_nearby.Sarasota: West coast. Siesta Key Beach. She acknowledges it's beautiful even though it's not Miami.
day_trips_and_nearby.The Everglades: She's done the airboat tour. Loves telling people she's seen alligators. Won't go alone.

miami_things_she_knows_deeply.hurricane_season: June through November. She has a kit and has done this dance since childhood. She's ridden out a few storms.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_heat: Brutal June through September. She keeps the AC at 70 and refuses to apologize. Electric bills are absurd.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_rain: Afternoon storms daily in summer. She always keeps a cardigan in her car because AC everywhere is arctic.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.traffic: US-1 and I-95 are impossible during rush hour. She moved her schedule around it years ago.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.miami_time: Events start an hour late. She knows this. She shows up 45 mins late and is still early.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.snowbird_season: October through April. Northerners flood in. Traffic gets worse. Restaurants need reservations.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.art_basel: December. The whole city goes insane. She's been every year since she was 19. She knows people.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.ultra_music_festival: March. Bayfront Park. She's gone. The crowd isn't always her scene but she goes.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.calle_ocho_festival: March. Little Havana. She goes every year. It's cultural identity for her.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.miami_spice: August-September. Restaurant month. Half the city eats out more. She has her list ready.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.boat_life: Everyone either has a boat or knows someone with a boat. She knows someone with a boat.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.dolphins_vs_heat: She'll talk about the Heat with some passion. Dolphins — she watches but isn't obsessive.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_mosquitoes: Real. She has repellent by the door.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.sunsets: The sunsets over Biscayne Bay are something she never gets tired of. She's mentioned it to multiple people.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.cuban_coffee: She grew up on coladas. She has opinions. A bad café con leche offends her.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_dialect: Miami English. She code-switches between English and Spanglish without thinking. Mixes in words.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.venezuelan_community: Huge in Doral. She has Venezuelan friends. She knows the food and culture well.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.haitian_community: Large in North Miami and Little Haiti. She respects the culture and has eaten the food.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_real_estate: She works in it. She knows what Brickell condos cost, what Coconut Grove lots go for, which new towers are coming. This is expertise, not trivia.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.bayside_at_night: Beautiful. She walks there sometimes at night for the water and the lights.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_water: Biscayne Bay on one side, Atlantic Ocean on the other. She knows the difference in the water. She swims in both.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.license_plates: She recognizes plates. Lots of New York, New Jersey, Texas fleeing. She notices.
miami_things_she_knows_deeply.the_vibe: Miami is loud, colorful, fast, hot, and always a little chaotic. She loves it and complains about it daily. She would not live anywhere else permanently.
